recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Only revisit this area if a later work-group decision changes the Study UID Identifier versus direct series/instance uid distinction.
issue_request: FHIR-19456 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and requested reverting ImagingStudy.series.identifier and ImagingStudy.series.instance.identifier back to uid elements, updating descriptions and examples, and avoiding urn prefixes for those structure values.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was applied on the moehrke_ii_uid branch. Git commit 131af0770aa6467c6907c7f556dfd51b8519f05d, merged by 5ccbf09b4fa6ff524e4ca689b53d72645d7b7aaf, changed the then-authoritative ImagingStudy source and examples from identifier/urn:oid encodings to uid elements with direct UID values and added explanatory DICOM UID guidance.
additional_context: ImagingStudy is active in source/fhir.ini. The current post-refactor StructureDefinition defines ImagingStudy.series.uid and ImagingStudy.series.instance.uid as required id-typed elements, while examples, notes, search parameters, and diagram links use uid paths and direct values. FHIR-19455, applied on the same branch, explicitly says Series Instance UID and SOP Instance UID use the id datatype directly; FHIR-54766 later clarifies why Study Instance UID remains an Identifier without reversing series/instance uid handling. Remaining series.identifier mentions are R3 rename metadata or historical workflow-warning suppressions rather than current element definitions.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the current build-scoped source already satisfies the final FHIR-19456 intent when read with related guidance and later same-area clarifications.

related_jiras.note: Same application branch adds DICOM UID guidance saying Series/SOP UIDs use the id datatype and are encoded directly.
Later R6 clarification explains why Study Instance UID remains ImagingStudy.identifier while preserving direct series.uid and series.instance.uid values.
